title: census.py brief re-packs a group's parts silently when its kept layout cannot be used, so --part N names other rows
goal: once a part of a group is applied, brief and dispatch keep every earlier part's rows under its number: a row the kept layout does not name goes to a new part after the last, and a group with no usable layout is refused with exit 2 naming why

run:
import os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census
census.DISPATCH_DIR = tempfile.mkdtemp()
census.BRIEF_CHARS = 200
census.row_block = lambda r, *a: 'x' * 120
census.brief_head = lambda *a: 'h'
census.owned_files = census.foreign_files = lambda *a: []
ctx = {'date': '2026-10-21', 'flog': 'f', 'log': 'l'}
mk = lambda i, o='': ({'id': i, 'outcome': o}, None, None)
ids = lambda packed: [[m[0]['id'] for m, _ in p] for p in packed]
first = ids(census.brief_packs('g1', [mk('S-a'), mk('S-c')], ctx)[0])
later = ids(census.brief_packs('g1', [mk('S-a', 'confirmed'), mk('S-b'), mk('S-c')], ctx)[0])
print('before', first, 'after part 1 applied and S-b added', later)
sys.exit(0 if later[:2] == first and any('S-b' in p for p in later[2:]) else 1)

import contextlib, io, os, sys, tempfile, types
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import census
census.DISPATCH_DIR = tempfile.mkdtemp()
census.BRIEF_CHARS = 200
census.row_block = lambda r, *a: "x" * 120
census.brief_head = lambda *a: "h"
census.owned_files = census.foreign_files = lambda *a: []
mk = lambda i, o="": ({"id": i, "outcome": o}, None, None)
ctx = {"date": "2026-10-21", "flog": "f", "log": "l", "members": {"g1": [mk("S-a", "confirmed"), mk("S-b")]}, "groups": ["g1"]}
census.phase2_args = lambda a: ([], "")
census.phase2_context = lambda rows, log, factdiff, group: ctx
path = census.parts_file("g1", ctx)
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
open(path, "w").write("not json")
a = types.SimpleNamespace(log="l", factdiff=None, group="g1", part=1)
out = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
    code = census.cmd_brief(a, None)
text = out.getvalue().strip()
print("exit", code, "| refusal text:", text[:120])
sys.exit(0 if code == 2 and "parts.json" in text else 1)

notes: SP-gavrmuvx review of ST-bh3yjx7o, 2026-10-21 (headless reviewer, read-only; verified by the manager by reading census.py brief_packs). Premise: the repro fails on eb35aff07 (S-c moves from part 2 to part 3). Same review, to settle in this item: (a) the layout is written only while no member has an outcome, so a group first seen with a held row never gets one; (b) brief_packs writes parts.json from groups, brief and dispatch --dry-run, which web-sources.md calls read-only and 'changes nothing'; (c) web-sources.md says an applied row is 'printed as already applied' but part_text leaves it out; (d) ST-bh3yjx7o's check mocked brief_parts, so the layout code never ran under it. A fresh census is not affected: groups writes every layout before any apply. Plan 2026-10-24: premise reproduces (repro and check 0 fail on the base). Check 0 reads clause 2 as: parts.json exists but cannot be read while a member holds an outcome, so brief exits 2 naming parts.json; a missing file is written fresh from the current rows (review point a), so a group first seen with a held row gets a layout.
